arStrings.szText: {c_important}Grizzly Rage{/c} is now a {c_important}Werewolf{/c} Skill and Shapeshifts you into a Dire Werewolf. Dire Werewolves gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%x|]{/c} Critical Strike Damage, {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%x|]{/c} bonus Poisoning damage and Spirit Cost Reduction instead of Armor. In addition, kills Heal you for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life.
